# `Q-21-6` — Inline Reference Ignored By Typst

> A cited key is defined both in the front-matter `references:` list
> and in a `bibliography:` file. Typst uses the entry from the file and
> ignores the inline one.

## What this means

By default, Typst output formats citations with Typst's own
bibliography, which reads only the files listed in `bibliography:`. When
the same key is also defined under `references:` in the front matter,
that inline entry has no effect on the output. The render still
completes, using the entry from the bibliography file.

## Why this happens

The document defines an entry twice, for example while moving
references from front matter into a `.bib` file:

``` yaml
---
format: typst
bibliography: refs.bib   # also defines smith2020
references:
  - id: smith2020
    type: webpage
    title: A page
---
```

## How to fix

Remove one of the two entries so the document matches what Typst
renders. If you want the inline entry to be used, set `citeproc: true`:
citeproc then formats the citations and reads both `references:` and
`bibliography:`.

- [`Q-21-5`](Q-21-5.qmd) — the cited key is defined only in
  `references:`, so Typst cannot resolve it at all.
